text.title: GovTech FOIA / Records-Retention BA Pack Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Is the system operated by or for a public body subject to access-to-information and records law (US federal or state, UK, EU member, CA federal or provincial)?

branch.conclusion: Skip this methodology. A private-sector system has no FOIA or records-schedule obligation; use the ordinary privacy and accessibility methodologies instead.

branch.question: Is every record class in the data model mapped to a retention period, disposition and schedule item signed by the records officer?

branch.conclusion: Block. Build the record-class inventory and schedule map, then obtain the records officer's signature per r-named-records-and-access-officers, before any other section of the pack.

branch.question: Does every store have an export path inside the statutory clock with exempt fields tagged, and are the WCAG AA gate, clause log and public-notice buffer in place?

branch.conclusion: Block. Name or build the export path per store; remove any store that cannot produce records within 20 working days.
Block. Produce the exemption map and tag fields at schema level; estimate manual-review cost for mixed free text.
Block. Add per-flow assistive-technology tests and the no-critical-failure gate to the launch checklist.
Block. Log every technical-consequence clause with decision, status and evidence.
Block. Reserve the notice and clearance window (at least 90 days plus review time under PRA) and re-baseline launch.

branch.when: export_path_missing == false AND exempt_fields_untagged == false AND wcag_gate_missing == false AND open_clauses_unlogged == false AND (notice_period_required == false OR buffer_scheduled == true)
branch.conclusion: Produce the full pack: retention schedule, export paths and exemption map, channel capture inventory, accessibility audit plan, clause review log, notice buffer, with both officers named.

example.p: State agency portal, so public_body true. Record classes mapped to the state archives schedule and signed. Case-note free text held applicant SSNs, so exempt_fields_untagged true → r-exempt-fields-tagged-in-schema: notes split into structured fields before continuing.
